Favvy, redesigned

Seven new directions for the FavCircles heart mascot. In each one the heart is rounded and glossy and the face is drawn right on it, with no white sticker disc. As a register figure, the NFC tag sits inside behind the eyes. Five of them have been built as 3D models.

1. Puff2. Pin Heart3. Wink4. Local Explorer5. Gem6. Gummy7. NeonExpressions
1

Puff

The classic, done right

A soft, round heart with a glossy shine, big sparkly eyes and rosy cheeks. No sticker face: the face is drawn right on the heart.

As a figure: a rounded body instead of a flat cut-out, with the NFC tag behind the face. The safest pick for every kind of store.

2

Pin Heart

Love + places

The heart's point is a map pin, standing on a "you are here" ring. Says favorite and place in one shape, the most FavCircles of the set.

As a figure: the pin tip sits in a round base with the rings raised on it. Could double as the app icon and the map pin for saved favorites.

3

Wink

Playful, a little cheeky

A sunset pink-to-orange heart, tilted, winking with its tongue out and waving hello. The one with the most personality, the one people would name and post.

As a figure: the tilt and the raised arm give it movement on the counter. The colors fade with a gradient filament, or print in two pinks.

4

Local Explorer

Knows the good spots

Favvy in a tilted beret, holding open a map with a dotted route to a heart. A friend who loves finding places, which is what the app is.

As a figure: the beret is the swappable city piece (cowboy hat for Nashville, crown for Charlotte), and the map is a flat panel that's easy to print.

5

Gem

A prize worth tapping

A heart cut like a ruby, sitting on a gold pedestal. Your favorite places are treasures, and the reward feels like one. The most unusual and grown-up of the set.

As a figure: flat facets print beautifully and catch the light on a counter. Silk or translucent pink filament makes it sparkle.

6

Gummy

Squishy, see-through

A strawberry-jelly heart, a little squished, with bubbles inside and a wet-looking shine. Sweet and tactile: it looks like something you'd want to touch, which is the point.

As a figure: printed in translucent pink, light shines through it. A small white disc inside (over the NFC tag) shows where to tap without a sticker face.

No 3D render yet. Needs a real print in clear pink plastic to judge; a render can't show light passing through.
7

Neon

Night out

Favvy as a glowing neon sign. Made for bars, cocktail lounges and late-night spots, and a natural for a window decal or a light-up register piece.

As a figure: printed in glow-in-the-dark or clear filament over a small LED puck. The same drawing works as a simple one-color sticker.

No 3D render yet. Needs a real print or LED piece to judge; a render can't show the glow.
